headline: NEWCORE GOLD SEWUM HITS 1.37 g/t Au OVER 24m — BONUS 9.24 g/t OVER 1.9m BELOW PIT LIMITS AT ENCHI GHANA
snippet: Newcore Gold Ltd. released additional drill results from its 80,000-metre 2026 program at the Enchi Gold Project in Ghana on June 16, 2026. Hole SWDD121 at the Sewum deposit returned 1.37 g/t Au over 24.0 metres from 94.0 m (including 1.93 g/t Au over 12.0 m from 103.0 m), with a second shallow mineralized interval of 0.55 g/t Au over 16.5 m from 30.0 m. Hole SWDD115 added a separate high-grade interval of 9.24 g/t Au over 1.9 m at 251.4 m depth — confirming mineralization extends well below the current pit-constrained resource envelope. Newcore expanded the program from 60,000 to 80,000 metres in June 2026 after earlier results demonstrated the Sewum deposit remains open along strike and at depth. Below-pit-limit intercepts are structurally significant for junior investors: they indicate the current resource boundary is conservative, and the expanded 80,000m program is systematically building the geological case for a larger pit design in the upcoming PFS.

headline: F3 URANIUM LOCKS 4 SUMMER DRILL TARGETS AT PLN — 3D-DCIP ONGOING DIRECTLY OVER TETRA ZONE DISCOVERY
source_name: Junior Mining Network / F3 Uranium Corp. (TSXV: FUU)
snippet: F3 Uranium Corp. published its 2026 summer exploration program for the 100%-owned Patterson Lake North Project (PLN) in the Western Athabasca Basin on June 16, 2026. The program advances four drill-ready targets (Targets 1–4) in the Patterson West area surrounding the Tetra Zone discovery, each prioritized on EM conductor and gravity low anomalies with geophysical signatures analogous to Tetra. A 3D-DCIP and resistivity geophysical survey is continuing directly over the Tetra Zone to refine depth and structural targets. Additional drill-ready targets at Broach Lake South (BRS Targets 1 and 2) are included. PLN is one of the largest contiguous land packages on the southwestern Athabasca Basin margin — the same geological corridor hosting Paladin's Triple R and NexGen's Arrow. For TSXV uranium investors, the four-target summer program launches one of the Athabasca Basin's most active new discovery stories into the peak H2 2026 exploration season.

headline: STRATHMORE PLUS URANIUM STAKES AGATE EXPANSION — 81% HIT RATE SPRING DRILL CONFIRMS NEW MIDDLE SAND TREND IN SHIRLEY BASIN WYOMING
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Strathmore Plus Uranium Corp. (CSE: SUU)
snippet: Strathmore Plus Uranium Corp. announced June 16, 2026 the staking of new strategic mineral claims expanding the Agate Project in Wyoming's Shirley Basin Uranium Mining District, following a spring 2026 drilling campaign that exceeded expectations. Of 48 holes completed, 39 returned mineralization above cutoff — an 81% hit rate — delineating a new Middle Sand mineralized trend over 2,500 feet and extending the existing Lower Sand trend 1,000 feet westward. Agate is an ISR project: shallow mineralization at 20–150 feet, ideally suited for low-cost in-situ recovery. The project is adjacent to Cameco and UEC land packages and directly next to UR-Energy's now-producing satellite ISR mine. Strathmore is advancing permitting through a Plan of Operation submission to the US Bureau of Land Management and Wyoming DEQ. At $86/lb uranium spot and $91.50/lb term contract — with utility contracting accelerating ahead of the 2028 US-Russia import ban — a Wyoming ISR project with an 81% drill hit rate and producing-mine adjacency sits at the high-probability end of the American uranium development spectrum.

headline: ICG SILVER & GOLD GETS ALL TUSCARORA NEVADA PERMITS — MAJOR DRILLING MOBILIZING FOR 3,000m PHASE 1 EPITHERMAL PROGRAM
source_name: Junior Mining Network / ICG Silver & Gold Ltd. (CSE: ICG)
snippet: ICG Silver & Gold Ltd. announced June 16, 2026 that all required permits have been received to commence its Phase 1 drill program at the Tuscarora District in Elko County, Nevada — clearing the final regulatory hurdle before drilling begins. Major Drilling Group International was engaged as contractor (announced June 3), and near-term field activities include pad and access preparation, contractor mobilization, water logistics, and spudding. The permitted program covers 3,000 metres across 25 drill pads targeting multiple priority areas identified through district-scale geological modelling and field evaluation. Tuscarora hosts both high-sulphidation and low-sulphidation epithermal styles within the same district — an unusual combination that historically indicates large systems. Nevada jurisdiction, Major Drilling mobilized, and all permits in hand make ICG a drill-imminent junior with near-term catalyst flow.

headline: STAR COPPER'S 15,000m BC CAMPAIGN UNDERWAY — INAUGURAL STAR EAST HOLE IN, COPPER CREEK DRILLING RETURNS
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Star Copper Corp. (CSE: STCU)
snippet: Star Copper Corp. confirmed June 16, 2026 that its 15,000-metre, $15M-funded 2026 exploration campaign at the Star Project in British Columbia is fully underway: inaugural hole at Star East completed, drilling returned to Copper Creek. Star East targets large chargeability anomalies coincident with elevated copper geochemistry and structural corridors; Copper Creek 2026 focuses on a geophysical feature roughly 500 metres northwest of the successful 2025 first hole. The campaign — covering Star North, Star East, Star West, and Copper Creek simultaneously, plus 3D-IP and MT surveys at Star Main — doubles the total historical drill metres at the district and targets a maiden resource estimate. For CSE copper investors, the BC jurisdiction, $15M cash, and multi-target simultaneous drilling provide the hallmarks of a serious resource-definition campaign at a moment when copper's structural supply deficit (Jefferies projects 491,000-tonne average annual shortfall through 2030) makes maiden resources in quality jurisdictions strategically important.

headline: ATHENA GOLD'S NEVADA PARTNER HITS 17,582 g/t Ag AT BLUE DICK MINE — 6km+ OF EPITHERMAL SILVER-COPPER STRIKE DEFINED
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Athena Gold Corporation (CSE: ATHA)
snippet: Athena Gold Corporation reported June 16, 2026 that partner Mammoth Minerals has completed Phase 2 reconnaissance channel and rock sampling at the Blue Dick Mine Prospect within Excelsior Springs, Nevada, delivering exceptional high-grade silver including up to 17,582 g/t Ag from channel sampling of adits and rock exposures. Copper results also highlight critical mineral potential: 3.02 m @ 1.61% Cu with 14.3 g/t Ag and 4.57 m @ 1.49% Cu with 24.5 g/t Ag. Results define high-confidence targets extending over hundreds of metres of strike within a 6+ km prospective corridor at Blue Dick, where parallel trends each extend over 3 km. Mammoth is earning 80% by exploration expenditure over five years, with Athena retaining a free-carry to DFS — giving Athena leveraged exposure to discovery at zero ongoing cash cost. At $70+ silver, a Nevada epithermal system with 17,582 g/t rock sample grades and 6 km of untested strike is the kind of early-stage high-grade signal that preceding drill targeting programs are designed to follow up.

headline: ADAM HAMILTON: GOLD'S SUMMER DOLDRUMS ARE THE SETUP, NOT THE THREAT — BPI AT 0 MARKS IDEAL ACCUMULATION WINDOW
source_name: GoldSeek / Ahead of the Herd (Adam Hamilton)
snippet: Adam Hamilton's June 2026 analysis on GoldSeek makes a seasonal argument that gold investors routinely misread: June's summer doldrums are not a bearish signal — they are the predictable sentiment reset that precedes gold's strongest seasonal stretch (October through March). Hamilton documents that gold averages -0.4% in June but then +1.1% in July and +1.8% in August, with gold stocks amplifying both directions by 2x–3x. What makes the 2026 setup unusually bullish for the post-doldrums recovery: January's $5,589 all-time high froth was completely worked off through the 25.5% correction to $4,165, entering the autumn recovery window at gold's least-overbought level in years — dramatically reducing the risk of a further summer selloff. Hamilton also identifies the Gold Miners Bullish Percent Index collapsing to 0% during the correction as the historic sentiment washout that has consistently marked the best entry points for mining equity in the current cycle. For retail investors building junior mining positions, the framework places the current FOMC-week consolidation near $4,316 squarely in the accumulation window the seasonal data predicts.

headline: LITHIUM FLAT AT $25.21/kg AS CATL MINE SUSPENSION + ZIMBABWE EXPORT BAN LOCK IN 37,000–57,000 TONNE 2026 DEFICIT
snippet: Global lithium prices held flat at $25.21/kg (Chinese pricing ¥170,500/tonne) as of June 14, 2026, consolidating after a 95% surge from US$13,433/t in December 2025 to US$26,278 by late January 2026, as two simultaneous supply shocks locked in the year's deficit. CATL suspended operations at its Jianxiawo mine, and Zimbabwe — Africa's top lithium producer — banned all lithium concentrate exports on February 25, 2026, after shipping 1.128 million tonnes in 2025. Zimbabwe's 2026 production of approximately 124,000 tonnes LCE represents roughly 7% of projected global supply. Great Wall Securities modelled the combined impact as a 37,000–57,000 tonne lithium carbonate equivalent shortfall for 2026 — the first meaningful supply deficit after three years of glut. For TSXV and ASX lithium developers, the structural shift matters: from Chinese supply surplus suppressing prices to a policy-managed supply restriction model (Zimbabwe following Indonesia's nickel quota playbook) that converts lithium into a permanently tighter market, directly changing project economics for the 2027–2028 production window that late-stage developers are planning toward.

headline: GOLD MINERS BULLISH PERCENT HIT 0 — RICHARD MILLS ON WHY TOTAL CAPITULATION IS THE BEST CONTRARIAN BUY SIGNAL IN THIS CYCLE
source_name: InvestorIdeas.com / Ahead of the Herd (Richard Mills)
snippet: Richard Mills at Ahead of the Herd documented a historic extreme in mid-June 2026: the Gold Miners Bullish Percent Index collapsed to 0%, meaning literally zero gold mining stocks were generating Point & Figure buy signals at the trough — a reading not previously recorded in the current bull market. The index had plunged from 100% in January 2026 (at gold's $5,589 ATH) through 30.77% in early June, then 7.69%, before reaching absolute zero — the equivalent of every seller who wanted out having sold. Mills documents that prior near-zero BPI readings in the current cycle (including a March 2026 reading of 3.7%) marked lows that proved to be highly profitable entry points for GDX/GDXJ held 6–12 months. The June correction low at GDX $33.15 has already shown a 9.2% recovery as of mid-June on the Iran ceasefire news, validating the contrarian framework: when the BPI hits 0, the metal's next material buyers face no overhead supply pressure, creating an asymmetric setup that the post-ceasefire recovery data is now confirming in real time.
